mu_name_from: MuMain's _enum.h:4182: MONSTER_MODEL_BALI = 32, so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster{32 + 1}, Monster33.bmd; the server's type is MONSTER_BALI = 150 (_enum.h:4521). The client's name is 발리 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:13817-13822). OpenMU's Version075 SkillsInitializer.cs:94-123 (CreateSpecialSummonMonsters) makes number 150 'Bali' at level 52 with 5000 health, 165-170 damage, 100 defense, MoveRange 3, AttackRange 1, ViewRange 7, AttackDelay 1600, attack rate 260, defense rate 75 -- the row put in mu.db's monster_kinds. It lives on no 0.75 map: it is the Fairy Elf's sixth summon (skill 35, the Orb of Summoning at +5), and nothing else.
summoned_in_from: Bali spawns nowhere, and a world cooks only the breeds that spawn in it (tools/cook.py figure_set). It is cooked with Noria, the elf's home, and the other maps borrow it as they borrow the Goblin (Figures::borrow).
rig_from: Seven actions, slots 0 to 6, exported with --actions=0,1,2,3,4,5,6 (the .bmd has eleven: ATTACK3, ATTACK4, APEAR and RUN past them, which a summon never plays). Keys: 6, 6, 7, 7, 7, 6, 13; the walk is the one locked action. 57 bones. BoneHead = 6, Bip01 Head (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3634). ZzzOpenData.cpp:3626-3635 slows ATTACK3, ATTACK4, APEAR and RUN to 0.4 -- none of them exported -- and leaves the seven at OpenMonsterModel's defaults.
sheet_from: Two sheets out of Data/Monster: rt03.OZJ, 256 square, no alpha, on the body (692 triangles); tgh03.OZT, 32 by 64 with alpha cutting 58%, on mesh 1 (28 triangles). Decoded under a bali_ prefix.
cutout_from: tgh03 is a .OZT whose alpha is the ragged edge of a cyan mane -- cut out, as MU alpha-tests it.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the sheets at 4x. rt03: a teal demon's hide, hard muscle with cyan highlights, clawed hands and feet, worn with gold -- an embossed loin plate with a figure on it, banded collars and bracers in gold scrollwork, gold horn tips. The hide is skin; the gold is set per island (islands_from). tgh03: a cyan mane in streaks with a cut edge -- hair.
effects_from: Not built: MoveCharacterVisual's `case MODEL_BALI` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:6019-6045) puts a BITMAP_ENERGY and a BITMAP_FIRE on attack_r01 (bone 33) every frame of ATTACK1 and on attack_l01 (bone 20) through ATTACK2 (and attack_r03, bone 41, through ATTACK3, not exported). RenderCharacter's edge (ZzzObject.cpp:315-350) draws it with BoneScale 1.2 and 1.08 where others take 1 + 0.1/Scale.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3626-3631: mBali1, mBali2, mBaliAttack1, mBaliAttack2, then SetMonsterSound(..., 126, 127, 128, 129, 127) -- offsets from SOUND_MONSTER_BULL1 = 210 (DSPlaySound.h:158), so 336-337 BALI1-2 on the move, 338-339 BALIATTACK1-2 on the swing and the flinch, and 337, mBali2, again on the death. Wired as bali_* in sounds.json.
islands_from: Thirteen islands for 718 triangles. 0 is the body (578), the teal hide in skin -- its gold collars and bracers painted on the same island stay skin. The gold is set apart by its UV on rt03: 2, 3, 7 and 8 (18 and 24 each, mirrored) on the banded scrollwork strip at the sheet's foot, 4 and 5 on the embossed loin plate, 1 and 6 (2 each) on the gold horn bases -- brass, as the Serpent crossbow's gold. 9-12 are mesh 1, the tgh03 mane cards, in hair. They arrived as skin, the monster profile's default.
